environment.host: GB10, 128 GiB unified CPU+GPU memory, single GPU shared with a resident vLLM serving pod (~5.7 GiB)

model_decision.chosen: Qwen3-8B bfloat16 via the transformers backend (configs/qwen3-8b.yaml)
model_decision.why: ~32 GiB unified memory was available at load time; bf16 weights took 15.3 GiB CUDA-allocated and a forward + 48-token generation ran without OOM, so neither the 8-bit retry nor the Qwen2.5-3B fallback from the design doc was needed
model_decision.out_of_scope: qwen3.5-27b config targets the nnsight_vllm backend (not implemented); the served NVFP4 deployment is a different model and Qwen-scope SAEs target the clean checkpoint

environment.dependency_note: uv add unbabel-comet pinned transformers <5, downgrading 5.15.1 -> 4.57.6; pyproject floor is >=4.57.0 and the test suite was rerun to confirm no regression

data.flores: 997 es-en dev pairs (ignacioct/flores200_es_en_dev_test mirror of gated facebook/flores), converted to data/external/translation/flores-es-en-dev.prompts
data.wmt: newstest2013 es-en (the Spanish dev set shipped with WMT14), fetched via sacrebleu, first 500 pairs in data/external/translation/wmt-newstest2013-es-en-500.prompts
